description: This Java class implements a command strategy for deleting a datatable entry associated with an entity within the Apache Fineract project. It processes batch requests, extracts URL parameters, and interacts with the DatatablesApiResource to perform deletion, handling responses and errors accordingly.

classes.name: DeleteDatatableEntryOneToOneCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy class that deletes a specific datatable entry for an entity, used within batch processing in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the delete operation for a datatable entry based on batch request data, extracting URL parameters, invoking the API resource, and constructing the response.
